step1_analysis.description: A CMOS RF switch branch connecting a transmit (TX) port to an antenna (AN) port. It uses a series transistor to pass the RF signal and a shunt transistor to isolate the port by shorting it to ground.

paper_reference.title: A High-Performance CMOS-SOI Antenna Switch for the 2.5–5-GHz Band

insertion_loss.description: Insertion loss from TX to AN at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz when the switch is in the pass state (series ON, shunt OFF).

sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided netlist uses very small transistor widths (5um) compared to typical RF switches (which use >1000um). This results in a high ON-resistance and thus higher insertion loss than the paper's 1 dB.

isolation.description: Isolation from TX to AN at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz when the switch is in the isolation state (series OFF, shunt ON).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the OFF-state capacitance of XM2 and the ON-resistance of the shunt transistor XM1.

step3_testbench.description: Measures Insertion Loss and Isolation of the RF switch at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz using AC analysis with 50-ohm source and load terminations.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RF Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 TX ON GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 TX OFF AN GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* 50-ohm RF Source at TX (2V AC with 50 ohm divider gives 0dB reference at matched load)
Vac TX_src GND dc 0 ac 2
Rsrc TX_src TX 50

* 50-ohm Load at AN
Rload AN GND 50

* Control Voltages
Von ON GND dc 0
Voff OFF GND dc 1.8

.control
* State 1: Pass Mode (TX to AN)
* XM2 (series) is ON, XM1 (shunt) is OFF
alter Von 0
alter Voff 1.8
op
ac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
let il_db = vdb(AN)
meas ac IL_2_4G find il_db at=2.4G
meas ac IL_5G find il_db at=5G

* State 2: Isolation Mode
* XM2 (series) is OFF, XM1 (shunt) is ON
alter Von 1.8
alter Voff 0
op
ac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
let iso_db = vdb(AN)
meas ac ISO_2_4G find iso_db at=2.4G
meas ac ISO_5G find iso_db at=5G

print IL_2_4G IL_5G ISO_2_4G ISO_5G
quit
.endc
.end
